answer_1.quote: Lay summarisation consists of generating a concise summary that illustrates the significance of a longer technical (or otherwise specialist) text and is comprehensible to the non-expert.

answer_2.quote: For each model, we report the average scores of several automatic metrics on the test split of eLife.

answer_4.quote: we ask human judges to evaluate each sentence within a generated summary along the following binary criteria
answer_4.guideline: 1) Factuality - is the sentence factually correct (with respect to the source article); and 2) Readability - would a layperson be able to understand this sentence.
